grade_source: BC Timber Scaling Manual, Chapter 9, Interior Grading
caveats: The log-market report is a species-group and sort average, not a mill-specific accepted-sort list.
Interior grades are Z/6/1/2/4, not the coastal D/F/H/I/J/U/X/Y grade family.
The report is a regional market reference, not an AFRF sales record.
Do not apply the average price to an AFRF grade volume without a documented species and grade crosswalk.
